note: What players see of the Return (The Return [COS-032]), stage by stage: an omen, and rumours that start going round. They never name the elder gods. Owner decision, November 2026.

stages.title: Signs
stages.omen: The stars at the edge of the sky flicker, and bells across Aetheris and Kaelmar ring a half-beat late.
rumours: Every bell in Hollow Refuge rang late last night. Nobody touched the ropes.
Black Sun preachers say they dream of a black star.

stages.title: The sleepers stir
stages.omen: Travellers back from the Ethereal Realm say the Hollow Verge has gone quiet: the Greylings have stopped whispering.
rumours: The wreck-islands in the Fields have all turned to face the same way.
In the Ossuary of Kings, the dead kings kneel to nothing.

stages.title: Heralds
stages.omen: Strange messengers have been seen in the Hollow Verge: tall, wrong-jointed things that speak in borrowed voices.
rumours: The Black Sun preaches in the open now, even in Hollow Refuge.
Something at the Asylum's door asked for the keeper by a name nobody knew he had.

stages.title: The first Guest at the Horizon
stages.omen: On clear nights there's a new star in the sky, and over the Black Horizon something vast can be seen.
rumours: There's a new star in the east. It doesn't move with the others.
Sailors on the Black Tides say the sea has started to lean toward something.

stages.title: The Sepulcher opens
stages.omen: Word comes from the deep realm: the obsidian tomb at the Black Horizon is open, and something walked out.
rumours: Shard-keepers everywhere are doubling their guards, and won't say why.
A crowned figure in the Fields is asking salvagers about the shards.

stages.title: The door
stages.omen: At the Black Horizon a door stands open, and everyone in the Ethereal Realm can feel it, like a draught.
rumours: The Asylum's Threshold Door opens by itself now, always onto the Black Horizon.
Every cult is moving at once.

stages.title: The Return
stages.omen: The sky goes dark at noon over both continents. The eclipse has come.
rumours: The Black Sun is singing in the streets.
Something is standing at the edge of the world, looking in.
